nodes.title: 30｜封装最终视频｜统一FPS + 安全音频
SHOW｜01 Create Video｜RGB + Depth｜统一FPS + 安全音频

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is a single replacement battle tank defined by <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> contains several tanks of the same general military vehicle type.
Use the large foreground tank as the primary appearance reference for <Subject 1>.

The other tanks visible in <Picture 1> are reference context only.
Do not interpret them as additional subjects.
Do not generate a convoy or multiple tanks.

Preserve the primary tank's:
low armored hull,
tracked running gear,
road wheels,
continuous tracks,
main turret,
long main gun,
turret proportions,
angular armor structure,
military camouflage pattern,
surface materials,
metallic structure,
and overall vehicle proportions.

<Video 1> is the primary motion, structure, camera, and scene reference.

The normal RGB regions of <Video 1> define the original environment and must remain unchanged, including:
the desert terrain,
dry cracked ground,
distant landscape,
sky,
dust cloud,
lighting,
camera position,
camera movement,
framing,
perspective,
motion blur,
and temporal structure.

The grayscale depth-rendered vehicle region corresponds exclusively to the tracked pickup truck that must be replaced.

The depth-rendered region is structural and motion guidance only.
It does not define the final vehicle appearance.

Do not reproduce:
grayscale color,
depth-map shading,
black outlines,
dark halos,
mask boundaries,
or depth texture.


motion_guidance:

Replace the tracked pickup truck with one single <Subject 1> tank.

The tank must strictly inherit the source vehicle's frame-by-frame motion.

Follow the depth-guided vehicle motion for:
vehicle position,
vehicle scale,
forward trajectory,
lateral displacement,
vehicle heading,
body rotation,
yaw motion,
acceleration,
deceleration,
turning trajectory,
ground contact,
suspension movement,
body pitch,
body roll,
spatial depth,
and timing.

The source vehicle performs a fast off-road driving / drifting maneuver across the desert.

The replacement tank must follow the same trajectory and timing.

When the source vehicle turns or slides sideways,
the tank must rotate and translate along the same motion path.

The tracks must remain in plausible contact with the ground.

The tank body should react naturally to rough terrain with subtle suspension movement,
while preserving the original source motion trajectory.


dust_and_environment:

Preserve the original dust cloud and environmental motion from <Video 1> as strongly as possible.

The tank may naturally interact with the existing dust,
but do not replace the source dust pattern with a completely different effect.

Preserve:
dust direction,
dust timing,
dust density,
ground contact region,
and overall desert atmosphere.

The generated tank should appear naturally integrated into the original desert lighting and perspective.


summary:

[single vehicle replacement + strict depth-guided vehicle motion reconstruction + strong scene preservation]

Replace only the tracked depth-rendered pickup truck in <Video 1> with one single tank defined by <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> determines what the replacement vehicle looks like.

<Video 1> and its depth-rendered vehicle region determine exactly:
where the tank is,
how large it is,
which direction it faces,
how it moves,
how it turns,
how it slides,
and when every movement occurs.

Motion from <Video 1> has priority over invented vehicle animation.

Preserve the original desert scene, camera behavior, dust, lighting, framing, and timing as strongly as possible.

The grayscale depth representation must completely disappear and be replaced by a naturally rendered tank.


avoid:

multiple tanks,
tank convoy,
duplicated vehicles,
extra vehicles,
original pickup truck appearance,
pickup truck body parts,
pickup wheels,
mixed truck-and-tank geometry,
hybrid vehicle anatomy,
incorrect track geometry,
missing tracks,
floating tracks,
wheels replacing tracks,
broken turret,
duplicated turret,
extra main guns,
bent main gun,
incorrect vehicle scale,
incorrect trajectory,
incorrect turning direction,
tank teleportation,
vehicle sliding without ground contact,
floating vehicle,
invented camera movement,
camera changes,
desert reconstruction,
new buildings,
new objects,
grayscale depth texture,
black outlines,
dark halos,
visible mask boundaries,
and unintended scene changes.
nodes.title: 18｜Ref2VA｜Picture 1 + 单Video 1深度复合 + A1
SHOW｜02 Save Video｜RGB + Depth人物展示

widgets_values:
【统一时间 / 音频规则】
① Video 1 是唯一时间基准；force_rate 固定 24fps。
② frame_load_cap 是唯一需要手动控制的时长上限；实际素材更短时，以实际 loaded_frame_count / loaded_duration 为准。
③ 主 H3 length、Face Refine fps、所有 CreateVideo fps、Face Output Trim duration/fps 全部由 01A 自动跟随。
④ 不再使用固定 5.0s / 5.1667s 作为 Face Refine Trim 时长。
⑤ H3 输入/参考音频保持原样；只有最终展示/保存音频经过 01B 峰值限制到 -1 dBFS，解决 SafeAVSave clipped source audio。
⑥ H3 原生输出为 24fps；建议 frame_load_cap 仍使用合法 H3 时间窗口，且总体保持 4–15 秒范围。

① 输入项保持不变：只输入 Video 1 + Picture 1。
② Video 1 同时进入 SeC 与 VDA：SeC 决定换哪里，VDA 提取整帧灰度深度。
③ 人物区域只做轻外扩：GrowMask=48，避免把人物周围大面积背景一起变成 Depth。
④ Mask 只做轻羽化：Radius 6 / Sigma 2，消除硬描边，但不产生大片黑灰晕染。
⑤ Depth 仅微柔化：Radius 2 / Sigma 0.8，压掉深度轮廓锯齿，不破坏主体结构。
⑥ 最终唯一 Video 1 = 原 RGB 场景 + 轻外扩、轻羽化的 Depth 人物。
⑦ OpenVDN DMD8 主输出保持不变。
⑧ Face Refine：完全照 V48 的 ADDON 结构移植，默认整组关闭；需要时用“KSK｜可选模块｜Face Refine”开启。
⑨ Face Refine 直接复用主流程的正向 Conditioning + 最终 AV Latent，只做人脸 Crop 低去噪二采；主输出不受影响。
⑩ Face Refine V7修正：不再复用主流程非方形AV latent。Face Plan输出512×512画布尺寸，单独创建512×512 H3 AV latent，并让 Picture 1 作为人脸身份参考后再注入Crop。
⑪ Face Refine内部音频只作joint latent占位；最终Candidate仍复用Video 1原音。
⑫ 展示规则：所有多帧 IMAGE batch / 序列帧统一用 CreateVideo → SaveVideo，不再用 Preview Image。RGB+Depth复合、Face Refine检测跟脸、Refined Crop、最终回贴均提供视频观察出口。
